items.source: Construct a new AmbiguousBindingException with the specified message.
items.translation: 构造一个具有指定消息的新的 AmbiguousBindingException。

items.source:
Thrown in response to an ambiguous binding being detected when
trying to resolve a method's parameter names.
items.translation: 在尝试解析方法参数名称时检测到歧义绑定而抛出的异常。
